claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Orbtronic 18650 SX22 2000mAh 11C as a 2000mAh preset with a 11C runtime rating.

The Orbtronic 18650 SX22 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Orbtronic 18650 SX22 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-10-30 or earlier.
